gbm_population_evidence.quote: Grade III Astrocytoma; Grade IV Astrocytoma; Astrocytoma, Grade IV; Astrocytoma, Grade III
Gliosarcoma or other subvariants are allowed, including the newly defined "diffuse astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype, with molecular features of glioblastoma, WHO grade IV" (Brat et al., 2018).

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to investigate the impact of targeting MDSCs in newly diagnosed IDH-wildtype grade III-IV astrocytoma by combining tadalafil with standard of care radiation therapy (RT) and temozolomide (TMZ).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven diagnosis of newly diagnosed supratentorial high-grade astrocytoma (WHO grade III-IV)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Relative change of MDSCs in peripheral blood

Tadalafil, an FDA-approved drug with inexpensive cost and excellent safety profile, has been shown to effectively reduce MDSCs and restore T-cell activation in the peripheral blood and in the tumor microenvironment.

role_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to investigate the impact of targeting MDSCs in newly diagnosed IDH-wildtype grade III-IV astrocytoma by combining tadalafil with standard of care radiation therapy (RT) and temozolomide (TMZ).

agents.drug_class_hint: PDE5 inhibitor (erectile dysfunction / pulmonary hypertension drug)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: reduce myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) and restore T-cell activation

agents.agent_name_registered: Concurrent and adjuvant temozolomide (standard of care; not a registered intervention)

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent temozolomide (TMZ) will be administered as per standard of care, i.e., continuously (Monday through Sunday) from Day 1 of RT to the last day of RT at a daily oral dose of 75 mg/m\^2 at the discretion of treating medical oncologist.

source_quote.quote: High-grade glioma with known IDH mutation.

coder_notes: Eligible population is IDH-wildtype grade III-IV astrocytoma (grade III included, so not GBM-only); coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named because grade IV astrocytoma and GBM-like molecular glioblastoma are named in conditions/eligibility. IDH-mutant tumours are excluded (IDH-wildtype requirement stated in title and summary). Pharmacodynamic primary outcome is change in MDSCs in peripheral blood.
